title: Ancient DNA Links Ice Age Europeans Across the Continent
paragraphs: Scientists studied old DNA from Europe. It is from the Ice Age.
A woman lived in a cave in France. This was about 30,000 years ago. Her DNA is very old.
Most of her family came from the west. But some came from the east. So people in Europe met and mixed. They were not alone.

questions.q: Did people in Europe meet each other?
